■ Why Whisper Notes?

There are already many tools based on Whisper on the market, so why did I made another one? My reasons were simple. 

- First, sometimes I have a wonderful dream and want to record it when I wake up, but I'm still drowsy and typing is difficult. I wanted a tool that would allow me to quickly record my speech and transcribe it into text. 
- Second, when a friend sends me a message and I need to reply at length, but I'm out on the street or eating, I wanted a tool that would allow me to quickly reply to my friend without sending a voice message.

Therefore, this product compromises between accuracy and speed: we use the largest model possible, but we don't wait for minutes to complete transcription. Normally, when you record a sentence, you only need to wait a few seconds to copy the text and reply to a message.

If you pursue ultimate accuracy (which can lead to extremely slow transcription), Whisper Notes may not be suitable for you.
